main_text.l: Confirmetur exēplo Pharaonis : In hocipsum excitavi te,&c.
Item Nebucadnezaris, quem Deus minatur se propter superbiam dejecturum post castigatam Ecclesiam.Jef.10.
Conclusio: Nō ergo fremamus nec desperemus: sed resipiscentes patientia fide & precib.ad Deum confugiamus.

l.i: An oracula prophetica quæ in N.T.de Christo citantur & impletain eo dicuntur, et-iam ad typos pertineant.

main_text.l: PRoponatur hæc quæstio amico, & declaretur hypothesi aliqua ex Psal.2. vel.16. vel 22.
Ratio ἀντίθεσις[?], quia video interpretes dissenti-re: alios de Christo restricte, alios de Christo principaliter & perfecte : & etiam de typis typice in-telligere.
Propositio : Omnia præcise de solo Christo, nullo autem modo de typis intelligenda esse.
Ratio 1. A discrimine typorum & oraculorum: quia typi implicite: sed oracula explicite, & sine involucris figurarum Christum praenunciarunt.
Ratio 11. Evangelistę & Apostoli, quę de Christo citant, ad eum solum restringunt.
Probatio: quia dicunt, in Christo impleta esse. Ostendatur exemplo Joh.19.24. ut impleretur Scriptura dicens: Partiti sunt vestimenta mea sibi, &c. vel simili.

page.notes: The Greek word after "Ratio" in the paragraph beginning "quia video interpretes" is only partly legible; the reading ἀντίθεσις is a guess. "dissenti" is read as printed (long s with a ligature-like form); the reading may be doubtful. "impletain" is printed as one word in the subtitle and is copied as it stands. Ioh. and Ief. are given as Joh. and Jef. by the i/j rule. The top of the page has a small marginal fragment at the left edge, which is not text and is left out.
